description: SET { identifier-12 } … TO identifier-13 (ISO §2023:14.9.39.2 Format 8, function-pointer-assignment), including the §2023:8.4.3.12 ADDRESS OF FUNCTION function-address-identifier sender — dated 2014 by its only possible operand, the 2014 USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER item (usage-function-pointer-2014). The plain form reuses the setToStatement shape every SET ... TO format shares (kb/Work PB4231) and re-routes on the receiver's category in SetBinder (the Format-9 pattern); the ADDRESS OF FUNCTION sender is its own grammar rule (setFunctionAddressStatement). SR20's same-signature screen is COBOL1959 and §2023:8.4.3.12.3 SR1/SR2 is COBOL1960. LIVE as of kb/Work PB452 + PB817.
vcr: ISO §2023:14.9.39.2 Format 8 (its operand is the 2014 function-pointer category, §2023:8.5.2.7)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. KSFPROTO IS PROTOTYPE.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-R PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING L-R.
END FUNCTION KSFPROTO.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. KSETFP.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    FUNCTION KSFPROTO.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 FP1 USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER TO KSFPROTO.
01 FP2 USAGE FUNCTION-POINTER TO KSFPROTO.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    SET FP1 TO ADDRESS OF FUNCTION KSFPROTO
    SET FP2 TO FP1
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM KSETFP.
